**Risk flags**
- Net loss in 2024: RM‑4,470,415  
- Low interest coverage –9.148 in 2024  
- Negative operating cash flow in 2024  
- Director 3 holds 54.63 % of shares  

**Overview**  
Mega Mutiara Catering Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company in the Food & Beverage sector, producing bread and cakes for retail shops in Pulau Pinang. It was incorporated on 17 Nov 1990 and has a share capital of RM 250,000. The firm has four directors, with the top shareholder (Director 3) owning 54.63 % of the equity. Financials show revenues of RM 36,015,739 (2022), RM 34,216,773 (2023) and RM 32,080,974 (2024), each year reporting a net loss and negative operating cash flow.
